title: CRLR/392/1992 of RAJJ KUMAR JAIN Vs STATE and ANOTHER

paras.text:
Recall Application No. 865 of 2003
In
Criminal Revision No. 649 of 2001
Hon'ble P.C.Verma, J.
 Heard Sri K. S. Verma on the
application to recall the order passed
on 26.06.2003.
 The grounds shown in the
application for recall of the aforesaid
order are sufficient. Accordingly
order passed on 26.06.2003 is hereby
recalled.
 Let the revision be restored in
its original number.
 Heard learned counsel for both
the parties on merit also. The order
impugned shows that the learned
Sessions Judge has found
involvement of the revisionist in
commission of crime under Section
307, 452, 323, 504 of Indian Penal
Code. The order was passed for
framing of the charges against the
revisionist. In my opinion, no
interference is called for in the order
impugned.
 Accordingly, the revision is
dismissed.
 (P.C. Verma, J.)
05. 12. 2003
NCM
